detail.longDescription: Benchmarked 3 secret scanners on 500+ web3 repos. gitleaks/trufflehog miss 73% of web3-specific leaks. drainscan catches them with offline derivation, BIP-39 validation, and SARIF 2.1.0. # security # devsecops # web3 # github # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community drainscan vs gitleaks vs trufflehog: Why Web3 Needs Its Own Secret Scanner (2026 Benchmark)
